location.venue_or_area: Meeks Bay Resort & Campground, Lake Tahoe West Shore (breakfasts at the Kehlet Mansion)

ticket_price.note: 2026: All-Access weekend USD 350; Supportive Sidekick weekend (no classes) USD 150; day pass about USD 125; youth pass (13 to 21) about USD 75; Thursday welcome dinner about USD 145; tent camping USD 65; under 5 free. Some price-to-tier mappings on the page are unclear.

add_sources.note: Site title 'Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival | Wellness Playground'; 'August 6th - 9th, 2026. Meeks Bay Resort & Campground'.
Venue Meeks Bay Resort & Campground; daily breakfast bar at the Kehlet Mansion included with ticket.
Facebook event (Google snippet): 'Hosted by Wellness Playground Retreats, Denielle Basom and 6 others'. Site lists Wellness Playground Retreats; Denielle Basom is also a presenter.

Pass list read from the homepage: All weekend All Access USD 350; Supportive Sidekick USD 150; Day Pass, youth, kid and welcome dinner prices partly ambiguous in page order; camping USD 65, RV site USD 325 (sold out).
Homepage gives wellnessplayground@gmail.com (waitlist and general) and a contact page. No vendor or sponsor opportunities listed.
Google snippet of organiser IG: 'Consider you butt CLEAN at the Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival! We got you covered! @goodwipes sponsor for the win! We are so grateful for this partnership.'

Google snippet of organiser Facebook: 'We are so excited for our local sponsors Drink Coffee Do Stuff providing freshly roasted beans for our Lake Tahoe Wellness Festival Aug 6-9th!' Another post thanks 'our local natural food store located in Truckee and Tahoe City'.
Homepage: New Moon Foods provides the daily breakfast buffet (matches the Truckee and Tahoe City natural food store thanked on Facebook). A SPONSORS block shows logos with file-name alt text only.
Sponsors supplied product on site: Goodwipes wipes, Drink Coffee Do Stuff coffee beans, New Moon Foods breakfast.

notes: Small, new wellness festival (yoga, sound healing, live music, camping) run by Wellness Playground Retreats; sponsors are local in-kind product partners, so it is an easy, low-cost sampling fit. IG: @wellnessplaygroundretreats is the organiser's account (Google snippets show it promoting the festival and its sponsors), so it should be attached despite the pack note.
